meta.seo_title: Financial Services Meta Ads Case Study | PPC Guru
meta.meta_description: How PPC Guru launched Meta Ads for a Canadian financial services firm, generating 5 Instant-Form leads and 11 WhatsApp conversations in the first month.

headline: A Financial Services Firm's First Month on Meta Ads: 5 Leads + 11 WhatsApp Chats
summary_line: PPC Guru launched Meta advertising for Ace Equity, a Canadian financial services firm, in July 2026. In its first month the account produced 5 Instant-Form leads at about CA$45.17 each and opened 11 WhatsApp conversations — genuine enquiries the team could follow up with. This is an early launch snapshot based on a single month of data.
client_context: Ace Equity is a Canadian financial services firm that helps clients with their financial goals. In financial services, trust and timely contact matter: growth depends on reaching people who are actively considering their options and giving them an easy, credible way to start a conversation. Meta (Facebook and Instagram) lets the firm reach that audience and open a direct line — through a lead form or a WhatsApp chat — while interest is high.
background: The firm partnered with PPC Guru to build a measurable enquiry source on Meta. PPC Guru launched the account in July 2026 with two complementary campaigns under a 'Loyalty' theme: a native Instant-Form campaign to capture contact details, and a WhatsApp messaging campaign to start direct conversations with interested prospects.
analysis: As a fresh launch, the focus was on clean lead capture and measurement from day one, and on testing two contact routes side by side — a form for people who prefer to leave details and WhatsApp for those who prefer to chat. The first month sets a baseline cost per enquiry that PPC Guru will optimise against as more data accumulates.
analysis_points: Launch a native Instant-Form campaign to capture client enquiries on-platform.
Run a parallel WhatsApp messaging campaign to open direct conversations with prospects.
Measure cost per form lead and cost per conversation from the first day.
Use month-one results as the baseline for ongoing optimisation.

timeline.what: PPC Guru launched two Meta campaigns — Instant Form and WhatsApp — producing 5 form leads and 11 WhatsApp conversations in the first month.
Gather more data across a full quarter to confirm cost per enquiry and scale the better-performing objective.

challenge: As a new launch, the account had no Meta history to build on — no proven audiences, creative or cost benchmarks. In a considered category like financial services, the task was to establish credible lead capture across two objectives and produce genuine enquiries the team could act on, while keeping a clean read on what each enquiry costs.

changes.why: Captures contact details on-platform so the team can follow up quickly with interested prospects.
Opens a direct chat with prospects who prefer to message rather than complete a form.
Tests which route produces better enquiries for the cost before concentrating budget.
Tracks cost per form lead and cost per conversation from launch, not clicks or reach.

benchmark: These figures cover a single launch month (July 2026), so they are an early snapshot rather than a trend. Cost per enquiry should be read as a starting baseline that PPC Guru will work to improve as the account gathers more data and creative and audience testing matures.
lessons: Give prospects two ways to reach you — a form for details and WhatsApp for a quick chat.
Capture contact details on-platform so enquiries are fast and credible for a considered category.
Measure cost per genuine enquiry from day one, not clicks or reach.
Treat the first month as a baseline and optimise from real data rather than assumptions.
Follow up quickly — in financial services, timely, trusted contact wins the conversation.
why_it_worked: Two lead objectives launched together gave the firm both form leads and live conversations.
On-platform capture kept enquiries fast and frictionless for a mobile audience.
Clean measurement from day one set an honest cost-per-enquiry baseline.
The launch produced 16 genuine enquiries across form and WhatsApp in the first month.
outcome: In its first month on Meta with PPC Guru (July 2026), Ace Equity generated 5 Instant-Form leads at about $45.17 each and 11 WhatsApp conversations. As a launch snapshot from a single month, these results are an encouraging start rather than a settled trend. PPC Guru will confirm cost per enquiry over a fuller window and scale the objective that proves most efficient.
cta: PPC Guru helps Canadian financial services firms turn Facebook and Instagram into a steady, measurable source of client enquiries.
methodology: All figures are pulled directly from the client's Meta Ads account for July 2026, the account's first and only month of delivery to date. 'Leads' are genuine Instant-Form submissions; WhatsApp conversations are reported separately as messaging conversations. Because only one month of data exists, this is a launch snapshot and is marked for review as more data accumulates.
teaser: 📈 Financial services Meta Ads launch: PPC Guru's first month for Ace Equity delivered 5 Instant-Form leads at ~$45.17 each plus 11 WhatsApp conversations.
